header: Stuck at loading after creating VPC domain
content:
After creating a new domain that uses VPC access, the domain's Conﬁguration state might never
progress beyond Loading. If this issue occurs, you likely have AWS Security Token Service (AWS
STS) disabled for your Region.
To add VPC endpoints to your VPC, OpenSearch Service needs to assume the
AWSServiceRoleForAmazonOpenSearchService role. Thus, AWS STS must be enabled to
create new domains that use VPC access in a given Region. To learn more about enabling and
disabling AWS STS, see the IAM User Guide.
